milind-soni-openmausbot.tagline: Cada bot con su propia computadora.

identidad.text: Every bot in the sidebar is a real agent — Claude or Codex running locally under the hood — with its own personality, its own model, its own cloud computer, and its own connected apps.

computadora.text: Every bot can get its own Linux computer in the cloud, with a desktop you can watch live while it works and take over at any time.

memoria.text: memory of its thread, model, computer, and apps

rutinas.text: Schedules (routines) can run once, on selected weekdays, or every 5–1,440 minutes, using either a bot's configured model/computer or the Cloud VM runner.

apps.text: A one-click marketplace over Composio Sessions: Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Linear and hundreds more.

coordinacion.text: OpenMausBot is the open-source version of that shape: a team of agents in a chat app, each with its own model, its own computer and its own connected apps.

aprobaciones.text: A permission broker turns every risky action into a decision you make, for cloud and local computers alike.

desatendido.text: To keep working independently of your laptop, you need an always-on host, such as a separately configured server or the optional paid MausBot Cloud workspace.

milind-soni-openmausbot.note: README: cada bot tiene personalidad, modelo, computadora y apps; memoria y rutinas por bot; equipos y group chats; aprobaciones. Corre en tu máquina, así que no es 24/7 salvo que lo pongas en un VPS.

leepokai-codync.tagline: Tus agentes CLI, convertidos en bots.

identidad.text: Persistent named bots, group chats, quote replies, bots asking each other for help, approval cards, per-bot memory, remote screen, voice calls and 'needs you / done' notifications.

computadora.text: Remote screen. See and control your computer from the iPhone over WebRTC, and let bots use the screen themselves through the built-in computer tool.

memoria.text: Persistent named bots, group chats, quote replies, bots asking each other for help, approval cards, per-bot memory, remote screen, voice calls.

apps.text: Remote screen. See and control your computer from the iPhone over WebRTC, and let bots use the screen themselves through the built-in computer tool.

coordinacion.text: Many bots, one team. Run as many bots as you like side by side, each with its own agent, project folder and approvals... Put several in a group chat and they answer in turn.

aprobaciones.text: The chat only shows what matters: your messages, each turn's final reply, approval cards and notices.

desatendido.text: Bots run on the Claude, ChatGPT or other plan your agents are already signed in with, on your own computer.

leepokai-codync.note: README: bots persistentes con nombre, memoria por bot, group chats, aprobaciones y herramienta de computadora. No encontré scheduler/rutinas en el README, así que rutinas queda en falso. Los agentes corren en tu computadora.

identidad.text: Spawn teammates from chat: every one gets its own bot identity, container, and memory, with shared rooms and canvases.

computadora.text: Container isolation - agents are sandboxed in Docker containers (macOS/Linux/WSL2).

memoria.text: Per-agent workspace - each agent group has its own CLAUDE.md, its own memory, its own container, and only the mounts you allow.

rutinas.text: Scheduled tasks: recurring jobs executed by the agent, with optional script gates that avoid waking it when there is no work.

coordinacion.text: Spawn teammates from chat... with shared rooms and canvases.

desatendido.text: Scheduled tasks: recurring jobs executed by the agent... The host keeps one outbound connection to the portal.

nanocoai-nanoclaw.note: README: un contenedor por agente, memoria y workspace propios, tareas programadas y equipos. Los canales son conectores; no opera una GUI completa ni tiene capa de aprobaciones.

nano-muse-nanomuse.tagline: Tu agente, en todos tus dispositivos.
nano-muse-nanomuse.note: Revisión previa + README: identidad, memoria y computer-use con aprobaciones en móvil, escritorio y web. Sin coordinación de varios bots.

modelflare-ai-anymodelbot.tagline: Bots locales con memoria y workspace.
modelflare-ai-anymodelbot.note: README + revisión previa: workspace, memoria y control del escritorio por bot; multi-modelo, rutinas, canales y aprobaciones. No coordina varios bots entre sí.

anil-matcha-open-duet.tagline: Equipo de agentes con computadoras aisladas.

identidad.text: Give agents a name, role, engine, workspace, memory, and approval settings.

computadora.text: Docker is only needed for the optional isolated agent computers.

memoria.text: Suparagent keeps conversations, memory, routines, and approvals in one place.

rutinas.text: Add teammates or create a routine when you want to split up or repeat work.

coordinacion.text: A request goes to a Claude or Codex team lead, who delegates work to specialists. Teammates can share a project folder, and you review actions when approval is required.

aprobaciones.text: Choose Ask first to pause for approval before actions that change files or systems.

desatendido.text: Use the desktop app or host the server yourself; the desktop app and server are experimental.

anil-matcha-open-duet.note: README: agentes con nombre, memoria, rutinas, computadora aislada y aprobaciones; un líder delega en especialistas. El servidor puede quedar corriendo.

rokaswk-threebot.tagline: Un hilo de T3 convertido en bot.
rokaswk-threebot.note: README: bot con memoria Markdown, rutinas, subagentes, navegador de T3 con control y aprobaciones. Depende de T3 Code y corre en tu máquina.

cosmicstack-labs-mercury-agent.tagline: Asistente y equipo de bots autoalojado.

identidad.text: Mercury is an open-source agent with a personality you write yourself, a memory that stays on your disk, and a permission system that sits between the model and your machine.

computadora.text: It reads and writes your files, runs commands, ships code through git and GitHub, researches the web and keeps a schedule.

memoria.text: Second Brain: typed, deduplicated facts in SQLite with full-text search, all on your disk.

rutinas.text: Scheduled automations - Mercury Bots run on schedules, hand work to each other, and deliver finished files.

coordinacion.text: Mercury Bots gives it a team. Persistent specialists research, write and ship on their own schedule.

aprobaciones.text: It asks before it acts. File access is scoped per folder, shell commands pass through a blocklist and an approval step.

desatendido.text: The runtime runs as a login service (LaunchAgent on macOS, systemd on Linux, Task Scheduler on Windows) and restarts itself after a crash.

cosmicstack-labs-mercury-agent.note: README: memoria en SQLite, scheduler, bots persistentes con especialistas, aprobaciones, daemon always-on. Opera archivos, shell, git y web; no es una GUI completa.

opencrabs-opencrabs.tagline: Un agente autónomo en un solo binario.
opencrabs-opencrabs.note: Revisión previa + README: identidad, runtime persistente, rutinas y trabajo desatendido en Rust. Sin evidencia de apps GUI, memoria acumulada ni coordinación de equipo.

microclaw-microclaw.note: README: asistente self-hosted que vive en canales de chat, con memoria, rutinas y trabajo en segundo plano. No opera apps GUI.

orkas-ai-orkas.tagline: Una oficina de agentes en tu escritorio.

identidad.text: 16 specialists ship with the app, each with its own skills, memory and tools.

computadora.text: Orkas runs on your computer. It is a local-first multi-agent desktop app.

memoria.text: A project holds the goal, rules, memory and files, so every new conversation picks up where the last one left off.

rutinas.text: Scheduled automations - run any task hourly, daily, weekly or monthly.

coordinacion.text: A Commander that plans, delegates and does the rest - it breaks down goals, picks the right agents, skills, connectors and tools.

desatendido.text: Orkas runs on your computer. Automations catch up their most recent missed run when the computer wakes or Orkas starts.

orkas-ai-orkas.note: README: proyectos con memoria, 16 especialistas, un Commander que delega y automatizaciones programadas. Es local-first; no hay evidencia de operar apps GUI ni aprobaciones formales.

ryder-sun-meldwork.note: Revisión previa + README: app de escritorio local-first donde varios agentes trabajan juntos. Sin evidencia de rutinas o apps GUI.

777genius-agent-teams-ai.note: Revisión previa + README: app de escritorio para montar equipos de agentes con roles y un líder. Sin evidencia de rutinas o computadora completa.

fei2411-ds-bot.tagline: Bots de larga vida sobre DeepSeek Harness.
fei2411-ds-bot.note: Revisión previa + README: instalador y cliente de bots de larga vida sobre DeepSeek Harness. Sin evidencia de apps GUI o rutinas.

ai-timon-timon.note: Revisión previa + README: equipo de agentes que corre en tu máquina y trabaja con tus suscripciones CLI; aprobaciones y trabajo desatendido.

nousresearch-hermes-agent.tagline: Agente generalista con memoria y skills.

identidad.text: Hermes Agent is a general-purpose agent platform... it grows with you.

computadora.text: Six built-in terminal backends - local, Docker, SSH, Modal, Daytona, and Vercel Sandbox - plus plugin backends.

memoria.text: Agent-curated memory with periodic nudges. Autonomous skill creation after complex tasks. Skills self-improve during use.

rutinas.text: Built-in cron scheduler with delivery to any platform. Daily reports, nightly backups, weekly audits - all in natural language, running unattended.

apps.text: Tool Gateway - web search, image generation (FAL), text-to-speech (OpenAI), cloud browser (Browser Use).

coordinacion.text: Delegates and parallelizes: spawn isolated subagents for parallel workstreams.

aprobaciones.text: Security: command approval, DM pairing, container isolation.

desatendido.text: Built-in cron scheduler with delivery to any platform... running unattended.

nousresearch-hermes-agent.note: README: memoria persistente, skills que se auto-mejoran, cron, subagentes, backends de terminal, navegador cloud y aprobación de comandos.

androoagi-starnet.tagline: Una tripulación de agentes en tu escritorio.
androoagi-starnet.note: Revisión previa + README: app de escritorio local-first para crear una tripulación de agentes con identidad, memoria y coordinación.
